text:
Maya: quick sync 5 - we ran the hybrid routing + priming microbench overnight. need a compact econ + risk summary for GTN.
Sam: uploaded artifacts: https://gist.github.com/redwood/hybrid-174850 (includes raw slices + sims). TL;DR below.
Jordan: TL;DR please (cost per 100k tokens, p95, and any flagged regressions).
Sam: TL;DR: baseline = opt13b-int8 full route. hybrid = nova7b-int6 for short and mid w/14b fallback, priming intensity +7%.
```
baseline per-100k = $9.20, p95=310ms, longform F1=0.895
hybrid per-100k = $5.88, p95=335ms, longform F1=0.885
priming overhead = +7% tokens but +2.0% recall on search prompts
```
Tess: that's ~36% savings, right?
Sam: yep ~36% nominal. if you include orion re-rank cost for low-confidence items (~3% of traffic), net savings ~32%.
Jordan: where do we lose quality? hallucinations or structure?
Sam: mainly structure/coherence on multi-paragraph summarization >800 tokens. extraction/QA is near parity. We saw BLEU/ROUGE dips on long synth tasks.
Maya: product wants <0.01 absolute drop on longform F1. Is that achievable with routing tweaks?
Jordan: proposal: length-based split + cheap re-rank flow + warmstart cache for heavy users.
- short (<256): nova7b-int6 primary (85%), fallback 14b on low-confidence
- mid (256-800): nova primary (65%), 14b fallback (35%)
- long (>800): 14b primary, nova drafts for speed then re-run if low-confidence
Enable KV warmstart for known active sessions.
Sam: sim with that policy => cost reduction 30-34%, longform F1 within 0.006 of baseline if we run `orion-lite-rerank` on flagged outputs.
Tess: can you express savings per-endpoint? product wants search vs summarization callouts.
Jordan: quick callout: search-style (many short turns): -42% cost; summarization-heavy endpoints: -18% cost but risk of -0.007 to F1 if we don't re-rank.
Maya: rollout plan suggestion?
Sam: feature flag `hybrid.priming.v2`. Canary 3% -> 15% -> 50% with the following watch triggers:
- expected_savings < 20% absolute
- longform_F1_drop > 0.01 abs
- regen_rate > 1.4x or p95 > 480ms
Also sample 0.2% of traffic to full-eval (human + synthetic) for first 10 days.
Jordan: also add an A/B toggle for priming intensity (7% vs 10%) to measure recall/token tradeoff post-canary.
Sam: added `hybrid.priming.v2.priming_intensity` knob in the config.
Maya: put a cheap gating rerank `orion-lite-rerank` on the canary path so GTN can validate cheaply.
ops-bot: scheduled rollout `hybrid.priming.v2` -> 3% at 1748501300, healthchecks enabled.
Tess: for the GTN writeup I'll need an amortized savings appendix: please provide per-100k numbers for search, chat, summarization.
Sam: short table I'll paste into GTN doc: search: baseline $8.40 -> hybrid $4.87 (-42%); chat (mixed turns): baseline $9.80 -> hybrid $6.22 (-37%); summarization: baseline $10.50 -> hybrid $8.61 (-18%).
Jordan: note in doc: summarization risk = structural/coherence F1 dip; recommend rerank for endpoints where >2 paragraph synth is common.
Maya: OK. PR for ops + draft GTN recommendation by EOD tomorrow. Tess, Jordan pick up appendix.
Sam: I'll open the PR and attach the configs. snippet here for quick ops copy: 
```json
{ "flag": "hybrid.priming.v2", "priming": {"extra_tokens_pct": 7}, "routing": [ {"max_len":256, "primary":"nova7b-int6", "fallback":"orion14b-int6", "primary_weight":0.85}, {"min_len":257, "max_len":800, "primary":"nova7b-int6", "fallback":"orion14b-int6", "primary_weight":0.65}, {"min_len":801, "primary":"orion14b-int6", "fallback":"nova7b-int6", "primary_weight":1.0} ], "rerank_flow":"orion-lite-rerank" }
```
Tess: perfect. also log the A/B for priming intensity as `hybrid.priming.v2.intensity_ab`.
Maya: thanks. closing out 5. Appreciate the quick turnaround. :thumbsup:
Sam: np, ping me if GTN wants additional slices.
Jordan: will add a short note about monitoring dashboards (per-route F1, regen rate, per-user p95).
ops-bot: note: healthcheck alerting set (p95, error-rate, regen-rate).
Tess: ack.
Maya: thanks team!
